description: Candidate Ollama models for Adiyan, ordered smallest to largest. The installer picks the largest model whose min_ram_gb fits comfortably in the machine's total RAM. 'base' is the public registry tag that gets pulled; 'name' is the final model Adiyan actually uses. When 'num_ctx' is present, 'name' is built locally from 'base' with that extended context window (see context.modelfile.template) - the KV cache for a long context is real RAM on top of the model weights, so this isn't free. When 'num_ctx' is absent, 'name' equals 'base' and the stock model runs as-is with Ollama's own default context: the conservative choice for the tightest-RAM tier, after a llama-runner crash ('exit status 1', no further detail from Ollama) on an 8GB machine trying to load qwen3:4b's KV cache at 16k context alongside everything else Adiyan already has resident.

models.name: qwen3:4b
models.notes: Minimum viable - noticeably weaker coaching responses, and the stock context window (no extension) to keep memory use as low as possible on tight RAM. Use only when RAM is tight.

models.name: qwen3:8b-16k
models.notes: Default target - this is the model Adiyan has been built and tested against. Confirmed running comfortably on a 16GB machine.

models.name: qwen3:14b-16k
models.notes: Higher quality, for machines with RAM to spare beyond the 16GB baseline.
